items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I was a Zottie fan. And within days, he's not talking to me. And he's mad at me... I took him with his drums to the Blue Note, I set him up.

ctx.x: brother in law's house, I saw that he ate, I took him with his drums to the Blue Note, I set him up. I was a Zottie fan. And within days, he's not talking to me. And he's mad at me, which is worse, and he's evil.

Now that's going on. Now they start to drinking. I've got George Brunis, one Saturday night, five bottles are consumed, either three pints or three fifths, or two pints -- whatever it is, between who? Pee Wee, Zotty, George Brunis, maybe Chippy had a sip or something. She wasn't great on drinking. So this was going on. And Frank Holstein -- now, George Brunis is getting up in front of the mike, and Frank says to me, whatever you do, I don't care what else you do, beat him to the mike. To try to beat George…
And George grabs the mike away from him. And says, 'my mother thinks I'm selling stolen cars in Pittsburgh, but I'm not as you can see. I want to tell you about a tune I wrote.'
